OPTION_INSCRYPTION_CAMPFIRE.name: Campfire
OPTION_INSCRYPTION_CAMPFIRE.descriptionP: Warm a creature card by the fire: its creature deals [gold]+{Damage} damage[/gold] per strike for the rest of the run.
OPTION_INSCRYPTION_CAMPFIRE.descriptionH: Warm a creature card by the fire: its creature has [gold]+{Hp} HP[/gold] for the rest of the run.
OPTION_INSCRYPTION_CAMPFIRE.descriptionD: You have no creature cards to warm.
OPTION_INSCRYPTION_CAMPFIRE.promptPower: Choose a creature to deal +{Damage} damage per strike.
OPTION_INSCRYPTION_CAMPFIRE.promptHealth: Choose a creature to gain +{Hp} HP.
